profile_text.body:
High-Flyer is an artificial intelligence research and development startup founded in 2015 and based in Hangzhou, China. The company describes itself as focused on cutting-edge technology research that uses AI to inspire creativity and imagination. High-Flyer's operations span three main areas: a deep learning training platform called Firefly (萤火), Huangfang Quant, a hedge fund that uses AI for investment, and AI-focused basic science research.

Firefly, marketed as Firefly II, is built on task-level time-sharing as its core concept. The platform features a scheduling system with second-level response times and includes software infrastructure including a high-performance operator library (hfai.nn), a distributed training communication framework (hfreduce), and a high-capacity, high-bandwidth file system (3FS) designed for AI development. According to the company's site, these components enable AI models to scale across multiple nodes for large-scale parallel training.
